envVars.LOGGER_PROVIDER: Which installed provider writes: `console` (add logger-console). Optional — unset selects the first registered provider, so logging works out of the box once one is installed; with no provider registered (a logger-only install) every log call is a silent no-op. Deliberately unlike EMAIL_PROVIDER: a naming typo throws, but a missing value never does, because an outage caused by the observability layer is worse than one absent knob.
envVars.LOG_LEVEL: Minimum level to emit: trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal. Defaults to `info`; an unrecognized value falls back to it silently.
